title: Aerial
description: An aerial shot views a large area from a high flying camera so geography reads as a map, the figure small in land or city. Helicopter, drone, or a virtual path can carry it; altitude and a stable horizon are the facts.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Open a world. The high moving viewpoint relates a small traveler or vehicle to a broad environment.
It can follow, overtake, or abandon the subject so landscape becomes a force, not a painted backdrop. It is the wrong tool for a face.
If the beat is an eye-line or a whisper, come down. An aerial that never finds an anchor is weather footage.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Plan a safe helicopter, drone, or virtual path. Hold horizon stability and let foreground (trees, ridges, towers) pass to prove height.
Keep a visible subject anchor and avoid implausible jumps in altitude. Do not describe older helicopter footage as drone photography.
Prompt: Aerial of [Subject] from a high flying camera, geography readable as a map, scale first, the figure small in land or city.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it to make the place bigger than the person: a car on a mountain road, a rider on a ridge, a city grid. Do not use it as a default establishing shot if a street-level wide already tells the map.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: The Shining opens with an aerial pursuit of a car through mountain roads. Skyfall uses large-scale landscape and travel.
Lawrence of Arabia and Sicario treat desert and border as active ground, not scenery.

sections.title: Prompt it

blocks.text: Name height, the map, and the small anchor. Still: Aerial of [Subject] from a high flying camera, geography readable as a map, scale first, the figure small in land or city.
Video: The camera flies high over [Subject], revealing the true scale of the location. Keep the horizon stable.
Do not add a snap zoom.

An aerial camera follows a small blue car along a winding mountain road, gradually gaining altitude as the road disappears into enormous dark forest. Smooth forward motion, stable horizon, realistic road continuity and vehicle speed, no cut.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is an FPV thread through a window. The tell: the camera is inside architecture, horizon tumbling.
The fix: stay high, keep the subject readable as a speck or vehicle, and let the land remain a map.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Aerial in film?
An aerial shot is a high flying view of a large area, with geography readable as a map and the person or vehicle small inside it.
Aerial vs FPV Drone
Aerial is a high map of land or city. FPV is a piloted flight through space, often low and threaded, with the lens behaving like a missile rather than a survey.
When should I use Aerial?
Use it to open a world or to measure a person against land. Skip it when the scene is a face or a room.
How do I prompt Aerial for AI image or video?
Write a high flying camera, a stable horizon, and a small subject in a readable landscape. Example: Aerial of [Subject] from a high flying camera, geography readable as a map, scale first.
